current_behavior: The adl manifest builds public adl plus private Runtime, CodeFriend and operational binaries. lib.rs unconditionally exports private modules. cli/mod.rs dispatches portable and product commands; default YAML handling calls run_workflow. cli/run.rs imports execute/provider-backed modules even for print-plan and print-prompts. The successor Runtime already exposes adl-runtime run <yaml>, resume, keygen, sign, verify and other product commands. That command correspondence is not authenticated consumer qualification. Public five-package closure is independent and cannot prove this CLI. Source baseline cc5cc6788a and Runtime 11ce6614603532738e9ceffab093e35d96b262b5.
